encoder.pretrained: official ImageNet1K_V1 ResNet18, strict state loading; no UTA-trained weights
encoder.source_pairing: two streams from the same original AV file

folds.validation: next two actors cyclically; fixed before model scores

classical.weight_selection: mean validation-actor Macro F1; ties closest to0.5 then lower audio weight
classical.probabilities: native multinomial logistic softmax; normalized, not externally calibrated

audio.normalization: one scalar mean/std fitted on training valid spectrogram cells only

visual.backbone: official ImageNet-1K ResNet18_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1; NOT UTA-finetuned weights
visual.normalization: 512D pooled embedding mean/std fitted on training actors only

neural.model_selection: validation actor-macro F1; tie validation CE

missing_modalities.late: renormalize weights over available branches; both absent returns training class prior with unavailable flag
missing_modalities.neural: explicit availability masks and train-only modality dropout; both absent returns training prior
missing_modalities.early: NaN plus false availability indicators; training-median imputation; inference stress only

config.scope: All eight actors previously used in development; exploratory LOAO, NOT independent confirmatory ATC fatigue evidence. Same80train/32validation/16test recordings in each fold across all model comparisons. Frozen external visual encoding may be cached globally because no study-label fitting is performed.

uncertainty.interpretation: descriptive percentile intervals of fixed OOF predictions; 8 actors, overlapping training folds; excludes retraining/model-selection uncertainty
